article.story: New York Knicks (0-1, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Boston Celtics (0-1, 11th in the Eastern Conference) Boston; Friday, 7 p.m. EDT LINE: Celtics -2.5; over/under is 223.5 BOTTOM LINE: Boston plays New York in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. Boston went 56-26 overall, 10-6 in Atlantic Division play and 30-11 at home a season ago. The Celtics averaged 114.9 points per game last season, 44.2 in the paint, 15.8 off of turnovers and 11.8 on fast breaks. New York finished 53-29 overall and 14-3 in Atlantic Division action during the 2025-26 season. The Knicks shot 47.8% from the field and 37.3% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Celtics: Devin Carter: out (illness). Knicks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
